start: Member page of a member who left the gym
Member page of an archived member (the other direction)

user_sees: The button reads 'Archive member' in red
must_not: The plan dates changed by the restore

start: Member page; the internet is off

steps.action: Look at the Archive member button
must_not: An archive that looks done but never reaches the server

steps.action: With the internet on, tap it when the save fails
user_sees: A red banner with the reason; the pill and the button do not change
must_not: 'Member archived.' for a save that failed

user_sees: Each tap gives its toast and flips the pill and the button
must_not: The page and the Members list disagreeing about whether the member is archived

steps.action: Open the archived member again later
user_sees: Pill 'Archived'; all history still on the page
must_not: Expiry or dues reminders still going to an archived member
